div.font: In the right lateral ventricle, there is a solid ovoid mass

lesion with isointense in T1 and isointense in T2. On FLAIR sequence, it shows isointense signal intensity. After contrast administration, there is strong paramagnetic enhancement. There is no evidence of supratentorial hydrocephalus. The possibility of a choroid plexus papilloma was considered.

It measures 25 x 36 x 43 mm. Diagnosis on the report: choroid plexus papilloma.

div.font: A 41-year-old Caucasian male has been diagnosed with a WHO Grade 3 Astrocytoma. A lesion is located in the right anterior temporal and right insular lobes, showing
in both T2 and FLAIR. The patient has no history of prior craniotomy.
